name: shl.canRoute: bit 0->4 should be possible
body: assert(BUILDING_BLOCKS.shl.canRoute(0, 4, 8), 'shl should route 0->4');

name: shl.canRoute: bit 4->0 should NOT be possible
body: assert(!BUILDING_BLOCKS.shl.canRoute(4, 0, 8), 'shl cannot route right');

name: shl.apply: mask 0x0F << 4 = 0xF0
body: assertEq(BUILDING_BLOCKS.shl.apply(0x0Fn, 8, 4), 0xF0n);

name: shr.apply: mask 0xF0 >> 4 = 0x0F
body: assertEq(BUILDING_BLOCKS.shr.apply(0xF0n, 8, 4), 0x0Fn);

name: rol.apply: 0x81 rol 1 in 8-bit = 0x03
body: assertEq(BUILDING_BLOCKS.rol.apply(0x81n, 8, 1), 0x03n);

name: ror.apply: 0x03 ror 1 in 8-bit = 0x81
body: assertEq(BUILDING_BLOCKS.ror.apply(0x03n, 8, 1), 0x81n);
